name: axe DevTools
description: Web accessibility testing extension by Deque Systems. Freemium: core scanning free, advanced features paid.

name: BuiltWith Technology Profiler
description: Find out what the website you are visiting is built with, using the BuiltWith database (builtwith.com).

name: Cookie-Editor
description: Efficient cookie manager with MV3 support (migration landed in v1.11.0; current v1.13.0).

name: CSS Peeper
description: Inspect website styles in seconds: clean, focused CSS inspection for designers. By Sparkglare Sp. z o.o. (csspeeper.com). Freemium.

name: EditThisCookie (fork)
description: MV3-native community fork of the classic EditThisCookie (original was MV2 and removed from CWS late 2024): view, edit and manage cookies. v1.7.11, updated Nov 16, 2025. The CWS listing describes itself as open source, but the linked repo has no license file, so no license is claimed here.

name: Enhanced GitHub
description: Adds useful features on top of GitHub: repo size, per-file size, download links and copy-file-contents options.

name: JSONView
description: Validates and formats JSON documents in the browser for readable inspection of API responses.

name: Library Detector
description: Detects which JavaScript libraries are used on a page.

name: Lighthouse
description: Official Google Lighthouse extension: automated audits of performance, accessibility, best practices and SEO. Built into DevTools since 2019, still distributed as an extension and README-linked by GoogleChrome/lighthouse.

name: Octotree
description: GitHub code tree sidebar — 'GitHub on steroids'. v9.2.1, updated Sept 28, 2026. Freemium; official site octotree.io.

name: Postman Interceptor
description: Capture requests from any website and send them to the Postman client; also forwards browser cookies and Chrome-restricted headers. v3.2.1, updated Aug 2025, by Postman Inc.

name: React Developer Tools
description: React debugging tools that add React-specific panels to Chrome DevTools for inspecting component hierarchies, props and state. By Meta.

name: Redux DevTools
description: Redux DevTools provides power-ups for Redux development workflows; works with any architecture that handles state. Repo moved zalmoxisus/redux-devtools-extension -> reduxjs/redux-devtools.

name: Refined GitHub
description: Simplifies the GitHub interface and adds many useful features. v26.9.12 released ~Sept 12, 2026.

name: Responsive Viewer
description: Show multiple screens at once for responsive design testing. v1.1.21 (Oct 2025); 'free forever, premium optional' (responsiveviewer.org). Source at skmail/responsive-viewer.

name: Sourcegraph
description: Connect Sourcegraph to GitHub: open repos, compare revisions and search code from Chrome's omnibox. v24.3.8, updated Sept 11, 2026, by Sourcegraph.

name: User-Agent Switcher and Manager
description: Spoof browser user-agent strings per site or window, with randomization, Client Hints and navigator.userAgentData support. MV3, actively maintained (v0.7.1, Sept 2026; ~400k users).

name: VisBug
description: Open-source web design debug tool by GoogleChromeLabs: point, click and edit any page visually. Official site visbug.web.app.

name: Vue.js devtools
description: DevTools browser extension for Vue.js: inspect component tree, state and events. v7.x for Vue 3, v6 legacy for Vue 2.

name: Wappalyzer
description: Technology profiler that identifies the software stack behind any website (CMS, frameworks, analytics, etc.). v6.12.6, updated Aug 25, 2026, by Wappalyzer Pty Ltd.

name: Window Resizer
description: Resize the browser window to emulate various screen resolutions via preset and custom layouts. Listing text states 'Written on top of manifest version 3'. No license is stated by the publisher.

name: Bitdefender Web Sage
description: Flags phishing and malware sites in search results and lists the trackers on each page. Formerly Bitdefender TrafficLight (renamed in 2026). Free and proprietary.

name: Consent-O-Matic
description: Automatically answers GDPR cookie-consent pop-ups according to your saved preferences; built by privacy researchers at Aarhus University. Manifest V3.

name: Cookie AutoDelete V3
description: Automatically deletes cookies from closed tabs to limit cross-site tracking; the actively maintained Manifest V3 rewrite of the original Cookie AutoDelete.

name: DuckDuckGo Privacy Essentials
description: Blocks third-party trackers and upgrades connections to HTTPS where possible; shows a privacy grade (A-F) for each site you visit.

name: Ghostery – Privacy Ad Blocker
description: Blocks trackers and ads and shows exactly which trackers each page loads; open source and Manifest V3 compliant.

name: JShelter
description: Restricts what browser JavaScript APIs reveal to websites to limit fingerprinting and tracking; an academic research project from Brno University of Technology.

name: Malwarebytes Browser Guard
description: Blocks malware, scams, phishing pages, and trackers in real time. Free and proprietary.

name: Privacy Badger
description: Tracker blocker from the EFF that learns to block invisible third-party trackers as you browse, stopping them from following you across sites.

name: SuperAgent - Automatic Cookie Consent
description: Fills out cookie-consent forms automatically based on your preferences. Freemium: free for 40 pop-ups a week, paid plans for unlimited use.

name: Adblock Plus
description: Long-running open-source ad blocker with filter-list subscriptions and an 'Acceptable Ads' allowlist. Manifest V3 compatible.

name: AdGuard AdBlocker
description: Manifest V3 ad blocker with cosmetic filtering and tracker blocking backed by AdGuard filter lists.

name: Control Panel for Twitter
description: Reverts X/Twitter interface changes and strips algorithmic and promoted content from the timeline. Open source.

name: DeArrow
description: Replaces clickbait YouTube titles and thumbnails with crowdsourced descriptive alternatives; from the SponsorBlock developer.

name: Return YouTube Dislike
description: Restores YouTube's hidden dislike counts via a crowdsourced API. Open source.

name: SponsorBlock
description: Skips sponsored segments, intros, and other in-video annoyances on YouTube using crowdsourced timestamps.

name: uBlock Origin Lite
description: The Manifest V3 build of uBlock Origin for Chrome, using declarative rules with reduced filtering capability versus the full engine; the full MV2 build was removed from the Chrome Web Store.

name: Clockify Time Tracker
description: One-click time tracker with 50+ web-app integrations, idle detection, reminders, and a built-in Pomodoro timer.

name: Evernote Web Clipper
description: Clip articles, web pages, and screenshots into Evernote, with annotation tools and a distraction-free article view.

name: Grammarly: AI Writing Assistant and Grammar Checker
description: Checks grammar, spelling, and tone as you type across the web, with AI-powered rewriting suggestions.

name: LanguageTool
description: Multilingual grammar and style checker. In March 2026 the browser extension became premium-only; the web version stays free and the extension still works against a self-hosted server.

name: LeechBlock NG
description: Free site blocker with up to 30 block sets on schedules or time limits, lockdown mode, delay pages, and password-protected options.

name: Notion Web Clipper
description: Save any web page, link, or image directly into your Notion workspace for later reference.

name: Pace
description: Minimalist MIT-licensed Pomodoro timer (MV3): plan work/break sessions and it shows the clock time you'll finish, with ambient sounds and a gentle full-screen break.

name: Todoist for Chrome
description: Save any page as a task and manage your Todoist to-do list, planner, and calendar without leaving the browser.

name: Toggl Track
description: One-click timers embedded in 100+ web apps, with a built-in Pomodoro timer, idle detection, reminders, and detailed reports.

name: OneTab
description: Converts all open tabs into a single list to cut clutter and memory use; restore tabs individually or all at once. (Listed only in this category per dedup rule.)

name: Session Buddy
description: Privacy-first session manager: save, organize, and restore sessions, tabs, and bookmarks. v4.0.0 is Manifest V3 compliant.

name: Tab Manager Plus for Chrome
description: Finds open tabs across windows, spots duplicates, and caps tabs per window (rated 4.7 on the CWS).

name: Tab Session Manager
description: Auto-saves browser sessions with tagging, import/export, and cloud sync; ships Chrome MV3 and Firefox builds.

name: Tab Wrangler
description: Auto-closes tabs idle past a configurable timer into the Tab Corral for later restore; renders Chrome tab groups since v8.2.

name: Toby
description: Visual workspace that saves tab sessions into drag-and-drop collections on every new tab, with cloud sync; free tier holds 60 tabs.

name: Workona
description: Workspaces that persist tabs, docs, and tasks per project, with team sharing. Free tier reduced to 5 workspaces in 2026; Pro is $8/mo.

name: 1Password – Password Manager
description: Commercial password manager with autofill, password generation, and passkey support. Requires a 1Password membership.

name: Bitwarden
description: Open-source password manager with unlimited vault items and devices on the free tier, autofill, and cross-device sync.

name: Dashlane
description: Commercial password manager with autofill, password generation, and dark-web monitoring.

name: KeePassXC-Browser
description: Official browser companion for the KeePassXC desktop password manager, pairing over native messaging so the vault stays local.

name: LastPass: Free Password Manager
description: Commercial password manager with autofill, password generation, and cross-device sync.

name: Awesome Screenshot
description: Screenshot plus screen recorder with annotations; freemium.

name: FireShot
description: Full-page webpage screenshots saved to PDF or image with an editor; free core plus a Pro edition.

name: GoFullPage
description: Captures full-page screenshots of any tab with one click; exports to PNG/PDF with a premium editor.

name: Loom
description: Screen, camera, and mic recorder with instant share links; free Starter tier (720p, 25 videos). Rated 4.6/5 on the CWS.

name: Nimbus Screenshot
description: Full-page and region screenshots with annotations and screen recording; blur tool requires Pro ($60/yr). The Nimbus brand rebranded to FuseBase in 2026.

name: Screencastify
description: Screen and webcam video recorder aimed at classrooms and async teams, with Google Drive export.

name: ColorPick Eyedropper
description: Zoomed eyedropper & color chooser for selecting color values from webpages. Open-source project by qufighter; the repo has no license file, so no license is claimed here.

name: ColorZilla
description: Advanced eyedropper, color picker, CSS gradient generator and page color analyzer; samples colors from anywhere on screen.

name: Dimensions
description: Measure between images, inputs, text and other elements on any page in pixels. By Felix Niklas; open source at mrflix/dimensions. v3.0.1, updated Oct 7, 2025.

name: Fonts Ninja
description: Identify fonts from any website, bookmark and organize them, see font details, foundry and similar fonts. v8.0.4, updated 2025-07-10; official site fonts.ninja.

name: Page Ruler Redux
description: Draw a ruler to get pixel dimensions and positioning of elements on any web page. Community fork of the original Page Ruler with Mixpanel/ad-tracking removed.

name: PerfectPixel
description: Overlay a semi-transparent design mockup on the live page for pixel-perfect comparison (opacity, blend modes, per-domain layers). By WellDoneCode; 350k+ users. Freemium: Pro adds unlimited layers, rotation, dark theme.

name: Site Palette
description: Generates a color palette from any website for designers to use as reference; shareable palette links and downloadable previews.

name: WhatFont
description: The easiest way to identify fonts on web pages: hover any text to see font family, size, weight and color.

name: Dark Reader
description: Open-source extension that analyzes pages and generates a dark mode for every website to reduce eyestrain.

name: Honey: Automated Coupons & Rewards
description: Auto-applies coupon codes at checkout across 30,000+ sites, with rewards and price-drop tracking (17M+ users).

name: Just Read
description: Customizable reader view that strips ads, popups, and page styling from articles; optional AI summarization and a Premium tier for saving/sharing reader views.

name: Momentum
description: Replaces the new tab with a calm dashboard: daily photo, focus prompt, to-do list, weather, and shortcuts; Plus tier adds task-manager integrations and AI features.

name: Rakuten: Get Cash Back For Shopping
description: Activates cash back at 3,500+ stores with one click, plus automatic coupon codes and price comparison.

name: Read Aloud: A Text to Speech Voice Reader
description: One-click text-to-speech for web articles in 40+ languages, using browser voices or optional cloud AI voices; open source.

name: Surfingkeys
description: Vim-style keyboard control plus JavaScript-configurable custom keymaps, session management, and page capture (rated 4.7 on the CWS).

name: Vimium
description: Keyboard-driven browsing in the spirit of Vim: scroll, open links, search tabs, and manage windows without the mouse.
